Subject: Datadog / Grafana joint jumpstart kit — proposed co-engineering sprint

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. Datadog PS and our Grafana partners have been talking through a lightweight "jumpstart kit" to accelerate mutual customers through initial OTLP routing, dashboards, and a short optimization pass. I put together a short draft that covers scope, target success metrics, and a proposed 2-week co-engineering sprint. See attached: Jumpstart_Kit_Draft.pdf (attachment).

High level asks from our side:
- 2 full days of engineering overlap week 1 (pairing on OTLP and dashboards)
- 1 day of Ops/Prod checklist review week 2
- Agreement on target success metrics (throughput validated, 95th latency < X, dashboards published)

Would Redwood be open to a joint sprint the week of July 27th? If so, can your team confirm the technical lead and a PM to own scheduling? I can share a runbook once we lock the kickoff time.

Cheers,
Alex Turner
Partner Solutions Engineer, Datadog
alex.turner@datadog.com

--

Rafael / Alex — I can lead the technical work. A couple quick questions to make the pairing productive:

1) Auth & routing: will customers be using Datadog-managed ingestion keys or are we wiring OTLP -> Redwood -> Datadog? Need to know whether we should prep token exchange scripts.
2) Sample workloads: can Alex share a small synthetic payload set (10k events / minute) so we can validate batching & KV cache behavior?
3) Preferred OTLP config: any preference on gRPC vs HTTP/protobuf for the bridge?

Attaching a short config example we use internally: otlp-sample-config.yaml (attachment). I can also spin up a staging environment for the smoke tests.

Ben — good questions. Short answers:
- Auth/routing: Datadog can supply a scoped ingestion key for the sprint. For customers that want Redwood in the path we recommend OTLP->Redwood->Datadog; will document token exchange.
- Synthetic payload: attaching a 10k/min sample and an initial runbook: dd-jumpstart-runbook-v1.docx (attachment).
- gRPC vs HTTP: gRPC preferred for throughput tests; we can fallback to HTTP for customers with restrictive proxies.

I'll drop these artifacts in the shared Drive as well: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink

Can we lock the kickoff for Friday, July 30th at 10:00 AM PT for a 30–45 minute sync to align scope and next steps? If the team prefers earlier in the week we can shift.
